title: Mahanine mediated therapeutic inhibition of estrogen receptor-alpha and CDK4/6 expression, decipher the chemoprevention-signaling cascade in preclinical model of breast cancer.
authors: Samanta, Suman Kumar; Choudhury, Paramita; Kandimalla, Raghuram; Aqil, Farrukh; Moholkar, Disha N; Gupta, Ramesh C; Das, Momita; Gogoi, Bhaskarjyoti; Gogoi, Neelutpal; Sarma, Partha Pratim; Devi, Rajlakshmi; Talukdar, Narayan C
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Mahanine抑制乳腺癌中ERα和CDK4/6表达的化学预防机制，仅含少量分子模拟（小分子-蛋白对接），无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Mahanine (MH), a naturally occurring carbazole alkaloid, isolated from Ayurvedic medicinal plant Murraya koenigii (L.) Spreng, has been shown to have various pharmacological properties, including its inhibitory activity against different breast cancers (BC) subtypes. AIM OF THE STUDY: While MH triggers apoptosis in BC cells regardless of subtype, the specific mechanism of MH action is not fully understood. In this study, we show the effect of MH in preventing BC progression by inducing apoptosis in relation to estrogen receptor-alpha (ERalpha) and cell cycle regulatory proteins. MATERIALS AND METHODS: To assess the pharmacological activity in various in vitro and in vivo tests, isolated and pure MH was used. To conclude the study, cutting edged molecular biology techniques including Western blot analysis, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), molecular simulation study, and other related software analysis were employed. RESULTS: MH demonstrated dose dependent cell viability against drug sensitive (MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231) and paclitaxel resistant (MCF-7TR and MDA-MB-231TR) BC cells. MH also exhibited synergistic activity with tamoxifen (TAM) against estrogen receptor positive (ER+) BC cells by inhibiting ERalpha expression in MCF-7 cells and N-Methyl-N-nitrosourea (MNU)-induced mammary tumor in a dose-dependent manner while having no effect on vinculin expression. In addition, MH inhibited cell cycle regulatory genes namely CDK1/CDK4/CDK6/CDC25A and neo-angiogenesis through downregulation of CD31/PECAMs in MCF-7, MDA-MB-231 cells and mammary tumors from MNU-induced rats. MH therapy has been shown to be significantly able to lower the serum leptin level and to be beneficial against the initiation of tumor development in SD rats for up to 12 weeks. Molecular modeling study revealed that MH has antagonized the effectiveness of several types of estrogen those bind to the ERalpha and has comparable binding efficacy to TAM. CONCLUSION: Overall, the current investigation showed the ability of MH to modify cell cycle genes especially CDK4 and CDK6 might be responsible for its anticancer activity against different breast cancer subtypes. Additionally, this study will aid in advancing MH translational research to the clinical trial stage.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：马汉宁（Mahanine, MH）是一种天然存在的咔唑生物碱，分离自阿育吠陀药用植物麻疯树（Murraya koenigii (L.) Spreng），已被证明具有多种药理特性，包括对不同乳腺癌（breast cancers, BC）亚型的抑制活性。研究目的：尽管MH能触发BC细胞凋亡，且不受亚型限制，但MH的具体作用机制尚未完全阐明。本研究展示了MH通过诱导凋亡，与雌激素受体α（estrogen receptor-alpha, ERalpha）和细胞周期调控蛋白相关，从而预防BC进展的效果。材料与方法：为评估各种体外和体内试验中的药理活性，使用了分离纯化的MH。为完成本研究，采用了前沿的分子生物学技术，包括Western blot分析、酶联免疫吸附试验（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, ELISA）、分子模拟研究及其他相关软件分析。结果：MH对药物敏感（MCF-7和MDA-MB-231）及紫杉醇耐药（MCF-7TR和MDA-MB-231TR）BC细胞表现出剂量依赖性的细胞活力抑制作用。MH还与他莫昔芬（tamoxifen, TAM）在雌激素受体阳性（ER+）BC细胞中表现出协同活性，通过抑制MCF-7细胞中ERalpha表达及N-甲基-N-亚硝基脲（N-Methyl-N-nitrosourea, MNU）诱导的乳腺肿瘤，呈剂量依赖性，而对vinculin表达无影响。此外，MH通过下调MCF-7、MDA-MB-231细胞及MNU诱导大鼠乳腺肿瘤中的CD31/PECAMs，抑制了细胞周期调控基因，即CDK1/CDK4/CDK6/CDC25A及新生血管生成。MH治疗已被证明能显著降低SD大鼠血清瘦素水平，并在长达12周内对肿瘤发生起始具有保护作用。分子模拟研究表明，MH拮抗了多种与ERalpha结合的雌激素的效果，并具有与TAM相当的结合效力。结论：总体而言，当前研究显示MH修饰细胞周期基因，尤其是CDK4和CDK6的能力，可能与其对不同乳腺癌亚型的抗癌活性有关。此外，本研究将有助于推动MH转化研究进入临床试验阶段。
